title: I love it so much
body:
I’ve only been using it for two days and I love it.
I absolutely love the minimalistic design and the built in pomodoro timer. Such a great app for tracking habits. It’s the easiest and best habit tracker app that I’ve ever used. I recommend it to everyone. 

Advices: I think a built in,  to do list would be very useful. And also an other user already mentioned this , but having a feature that shows that you’re done with a habit for the day would be very useful in my opinion too. 

Overall I’m very grateful that this app exist. Keep up the good work:)
author: Milka🐮

title: Cant mark completed task
body: The app looks good but couldnt mark my gym task as completed because it was after the reminder.
author: Peter19860813

body:
Positive: I can add as many habits as I want. 

Could improve: when I am done with a habit, the color could fade, or the task could go to the back so I know I am done with it for the day. Another thing is that the habit counter could count how many times I do a habit a day, not just either I did it or not. Some more encouraging messages could brighten it and also I think a more organized monthly tracker which shows every habit in one review would be a great upgrade! 

Thank you for the app, and the other features of it too! 

Also I have to mention every other habit tracker I tried only allowed 2-3 habits for free. So thank you for making a no-limit one without a price tag. Keep up the good work! Have a blessed day!
author: Isten lánya
